# Made for More

> Made for More is an influencer sponsorship agency based in the Netherlands. It connects brands with creators who fit their audience, values and style, handles negotiation and agreements, and guides each collaboration from first contact to reporting. The agency works for brands looking for creators and for creators looking for sponsors.

- Website (English): https://www.madeformore.com/
- Website (Dutch): https://www.madeformore.com/nl/
- Process: introduction, match, agreements, campaign and results.
- Sponsored content is clearly labelled as advertising, in line with the Dutch Advertising Code for Social Media & Influencer Marketing.
